newsitem.title: USA: WLR to buy back 10 pct of shares. [CORRECTED 20:55 GMT]
newsitem.headline: WLR to buy back 10 pct of shares. [CORRECTED 20:55 GMT]

text.p: WLR Foods Inc has agreed to buy back 10 percent of its outstanding stock in a private deal with Cuddy Farms Inc, WLR president and chief excutive James Keeler said on Monday.

The stake, totalling 1,774,999 common shares, will be purchased for $10 per share in three stages. Some 50 percent of the shares were purchased upon signing of the agreement and the other half will be purchased (corrects from "the remainder... nearly 1.8 million shares) in March and late June, respectively, Keeler said.
Keeler said the stock purchased has been (corrects from "will be") held in trust and would not be available for public trading until August 1998.
"We firmly believe that this transaction will dramatically enhance shareholder value for the long term."
When completed, these transactions will eliminate the company's obligation under a share repurchase agreement with Cuddy Farms and its lenders, Keeler said.
WLR Foods, which sells turkey and chicken products primarily under the Wampler Foods label, said it had 17,783,009 million outstanding shares as of December 28.
